<b>Skewered Organs</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
15 [[Seared Organ]]s, 35 [[Shredded Organ]]s, and 10 Skewered Organs are required to complete the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> Wish, given by [[Huntress]] at [[Putrified Ducts]] (or the <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> Wish, given by [[Runt]] in the same location after [[Act 3]] begins).

== How to Acquire ==
Only obtainable while <i>Broodfeast</i> or <i>Runtfeast</i> is active. Skewered Organs drop from most enemies killed by the following sources:
* [[Sting Shard]] 
* [[Longpin]]
* [[Needle Phial]]

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] may carry up to 10 Skewered Organs, after which they are no longer obtainable.
